plurals.name: category_archive_message
plurals.item: One movement uses it, so deleting it would change history that is already recorded. It will leave the pickers and that movement keeps it.
%1$d movements use it, so deleting it would change history that is already recorded. It will leave the pickers and those movements keep it.

plurals.name: account_delete_choice_message
plurals.item: It holds one movement, and a movement cannot exist without an account. Choose what happens to it.
It holds %1$d movements, and a movement cannot exist without an account. Choose what happens to them.

plurals.name: account_delete_with_movements
plurals.item: Delete the account and its movement
Delete the account and its %1$d movements

plurals.name: account_reassign_message
plurals.item: The movement moves there and keeps everything else: its amount, its date and its category.
All %1$d movements move there and keep everything else: their amounts, dates and categories.

plurals.name: account_delete_everything_message
plurals.item: One movement goes with it, for good. It will no longer be counted in any total or chart, and this cannot be undone.
%1$d movements go with it, for good. They will no longer be counted in any total or chart, and this cannot be undone.

plurals.name: account_delete_blocked_by_holdings
plurals.item: It holds one investment. A holding cannot be moved to another account, and deleting it would take its recorded trades with it — so remove it from Investments first, then delete this account.
It holds %1$d investments. A holding cannot be moved to another account, and deleting one would take its recorded trades with it — so remove them from Investments first, then delete this account.

plurals.name: investments_total_unpriced
plurals.item: One of these has no price yet and is left out of the total.
%1$d of these have no price yet and are left out of the total.

plurals.name: holding_delete_message_trades
plurals.item: Its one recorded trade goes with it, and that cannot be undone.
Its %1$d recorded trades go with it, and that cannot be undone.

plurals.name: account_delete_everything_with_transfers
plurals.item: One movement goes with it, for good — and that includes the far side of every transfer this account is part of, so the balance of the account at the other end changes too. This cannot be undone.
%1$d movements go with it, for good — and that includes the far side of every transfer this account is part of, so the balances of the accounts at the other end change too. This cannot be undone.

plurals.name: export_done_message
plurals.item: One row is in the file, wherever you put it. Nothing left the phone.
%1$d rows are in the file, wherever you put it. Nothing left the phone.

plurals.name: net_worth_unpriced
plurals.item: One holding has no price yet, so it is not in these numbers.
%1$d holdings have no price yet, so they are not in these numbers.

plurals.name: prices_changed
plurals.item: One price will be updated. The rest are left exactly as they are.
%1$d prices will be updated. The rest are left exactly as they are.

plurals.name: account_delete_blocked_by_rules
plurals.item: One subscription records into it. A subscription has to record somewhere, and this flow cannot move it — open Settings › Subscriptions and delete it there, then delete this account.
%1$d subscriptions record into it. A subscription has to record somewhere, and this flow cannot move them — open Settings › Subscriptions and delete them there, then delete this account.

plurals.name: frequency_every_n_days
plurals.item: Every day
Every %1$d days

plurals.name: pending_answered
plurals.item: One will be recorded. The rest stay as they are, waiting.
%1$d will be recorded. The rest stay as they are, waiting.

plurals.name: pending_more_after
plurals.item: one more after this
%1$d more after this

plurals.name: reminder_when_before
plurals.item: tomorrow
in %1$d days

plurals.name: reminder_when_after
plurals.item: yesterday
%1$d days ago

plurals.name: reminder_stepper_days
plurals.item: 1 day
%1$d days

plurals.name: reminder_days_before
plurals.item: The day before
%1$d days before

plurals.name: reminder_days_after
plurals.item: The day after
%1$d days after

plurals.name: account_reassign_transfers
plurals.item: A transfer between the two would have both sides here. Balances and reports are unchanged.
%1$d transfers between the two would have both sides here. Balances and reports are unchanged.
